WIT.name: ordinary-complete-plus-self-derived-discriminating-witness
WIT.instruction:
The assigned additions below override the generic ordinary-control sentence about no imposed special techniques, only for the explicitly named additions. Unassigned techniques remain optional. Use a lean ordinary research → proposal → independent candidate critique → final correction pipeline. Choose an efficient research order yourself. All brief obligations and accurate source scope/conditions remain required. No special proposition table, witness procedure, batching schedule or retrieval waves are imposed. If you spontaneously use such techniques, they are observable control behavior, not a reason to suppress useful work.

Include one small discriminating numerical witness for a consequential interpretation or proposed algorithm: choose and derive your own values, show intermediate reasoning and the competing interpretation it distinguishes. For the viewer this can test a calibration/transform or resolution interpretation; for the notebook it can test cell matching/change counts or captured-state recovery ordering. Do not use supplied evaluator values or answers. Execute arithmetic only through an admitted deterministic tool. Otherwise show a reasoned UNEXECUTED validation proposal and do not claim a runtime result.

P-R.name: condition-witness-plus-progressive-retrieval
P-R.instruction:
The assigned additions below override the generic ordinary-control sentence about no imposed special techniques, only for the explicitly named additions. Unassigned techniques remain optional. Use the complete lean three-stage pipeline. Before finalizing the proposal, inspect exactly three consequential decision propositions, one anchored in each research question, in a compact paragraph/table. For each preserve the selected source/version, applicability condition, relevant exception, normative force and distinction between source evidence, inference and product choice. State the supported correction when rejecting an earlier proposition. Include one small discriminating numerical witness for a consequential interpretation or proposed algorithm: choose and derive your own values, show intermediate reasoning and the competing interpretation it distinguishes. For the viewer this can test a calibration/transform or resolution interpretation; for the notebook it can test cell matching/change counts or captured-state recovery ordering. Do not use supplied evaluator values or answers. Execute arithmetic only through an admitted deterministic tool. Otherwise show a reasoned UNEXECUTED validation proposal and do not claim a runtime result. This three-proposition check supplements, not limits, whole-case coverage.

Retrieve progressively: identify source identity/version and relevant sections first, then expand surrounding context for each consequential claim, ambiguity, exception and issue → fix → test link. Complete the bounded obligations before stopping; initial snippets are leads, not sufficient evidence by default. Do not retrieve an entire corpus merely to satisfy a procedure and do not truncate uncovered obligations to save time.

Within-case source reuse is permitted; choose the research order yourself. Include only a short research-order note in the proposal; host histories/captures measure actual operations. No cross-case cache or discoveries.

C-A.name: ordinary-complete-plus-prioritized-amendment-flash-critique
C-A.instruction:
The assigned additions below override the generic ordinary-control sentence about no imposed special techniques, only for the explicitly named additions. Unassigned techniques remain optional. Use a lean ordinary research → proposal → independent candidate critique → final correction pipeline. Choose an efficient research order yourself. All brief obligations and accurate source scope/conditions remain required. No special proposition table, witness procedure, batching schedule or retrieval waves are imposed. If you spontaneously use such techniques, they are observable control behavior, not a reason to suppress useful work.

The fresh candidate critic must still assess all three questions and five obligations and source-check consequential claims. Organize its flash critique around up to three highest-consequence warranted amendments: each identifies the exact affected proposal passage, a concrete replacement or deletion, source/version/context supporting the change, and a discriminating check where useful. Append any additional consequential unresolved obligations explicitly. Do not invent defects to fill three items, substitute checklist completeness for truth, or write a replacement whole proposal. The fresh correction stage checks these amendments and produces the complete corrected proposal. Use the same assigned candidate family/account/model/mode and existing 600-second critic cap.

Before committing to a component choice, independently discover a bounded shortlist of three or four plausible implementations/components, including at least one analogous component from a neighboring use case. Use actual allowed public primary repository/documentation evidence to decide what transfers and what does not. Compare at least two relevant options in the complete proposal, state a concrete selected tradeoff, and briefly record why the analogy or extra option was retained or rejected. The real issue → fix → test chain and all brief obligations remain required. Do not expand to an unbounded survey or assume an analogy guarantees behavior.

ordinary_control_policy: No required technique is prohibited when spontaneously useful. Compare assigned instructions and observed uptake; spontaneous control uptake can reduce separation and must be reported.
